messages:
Claire: Quick sync on the new in-product help drawer 023-04 prototype. I noticed inconsistent labels: some places say 'Guides' and others say 'Docs'. Feels confusing for users trying to find routing docs. Can we standardize?
Sam: Strong +1 for 'Docs' (matches docs.redwood.inference). Also the drawer links to the docs root; we should deep-link to the exact section where possible.
Mike: For deep links we can append an anchor param and surface a small 'Back to Console' option on the docs page. Example: https://docs.redwood.inference/guides/routing?anchor=policy-fallbacks&console_return=true
Anita: Accessibility note: the drawer traps focus but the close control has no aria-label. Screen readers will announce it as "button" only. Also the header isn't semantic (div instead of h2). Small fixes.
Claire: Action: unify microcopy to 'Docs' across console strings, make drawer CTAs open docs in a new tab (with tooltip 'Opens docs in new tab'), and implement deep-link anchors so context is preserved.
Sam: I'll PR copy updates. I'll also enforce that if a link opens in a new tab the CTA text includes '(opens in new tab)'. Tests will assert presence of rel=noopener and target=_blank.
Mike: Implementation note: adding console_return param requires a docs-side banner that is OIDC-safe. I'll stub the banner and coordinate with docs team for stable anchors.
Anita: A11y checklist I'll send: close button aria-label="Close help drawer", focus returns to triggering element on close, header should be h2, and focus ring contrast must meet AA. Also ensure the '?' icon has aria-describedby and tooltip is keyboard-accessible.
doc-bot: automated note: found 4 console strings using 'Guides' (ui/help_drawer.title, ui/help_cta.label, ui/route_explain.header, ui/route_explain.link_text).
Claire: Nice. Also suggest an inline micro-help icon in the routes table (right side of row) so users get quick context without opening a new page. 16px icon with tooltip 'View documentation for this route' and aria-describedby.
Sam: I'll implement the icon and add CSS for 16px and accessible hit target.
Mike: tagging @docs-team here: please create stable anchors for routing sections we reference. Also, confirm we can honor console_return query param to render a subtle 'Back to Console' link.
Claire: Thanks team. Please update this thread when PRs are open. Target: get copy + a11y + deep-link stub done this sprint. :calendar:
Sam: Will open PR tonight and tag reviewers.
Mike: I'll push a small feature branch for the deep-linking and banner.
Anita: I'll attach a short a11y checklist to the PR.
Claire: Great, thanks — I'll update the design spec and paste the final list of strings to change in this thread. :thumbsup:
